<thought>The mass spectrum shows a monoisotopic [M+H]+ at m/z 100.0524, which corresponds to a neutral molecular weight of 99.045 Da. This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of the formula C₅H₈O₂ (100.0524 Da for the neutral molecule). The formula has a double‑bond equivalent of 2, indicating a carboxylic acid (one DBE) plus one additional double bond or ring. A simple structure satisfying C₅H₈O₂ and DBE = 2 is pent‑3‑enoic acid (CH₃‑CH₂‑CH=CH‑COOH). Its SMILES representation is **CCC=CC(=O)O**. This SMILES is valid and matches the required formula.</thought>
<final_answer>CCC=CC(=O)O</final_answer>
